newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CLUB MUST GO ON, SAYS CHAIRMAN HALL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CLUB MUST GO ON, SAYS CHAIRMAN HALL.

text.p: Newcastle chairman Sir John Hall pleaded with fans on Wednesday to remember the positive role Kevin Keegan had played in the club's revival and not to condemn his decision to quit.
Sir John, on holiday in Spain over the New Year period, has been in constant touch with officials at St James' Park while the Keegan issue was being resolved.
He helped prepare Newcastle's statement issued earlier in the day and said the club now needed time to plan their next move.
He said: "It has all happened rather quickly, but the club has to go on and Kevin would want that."
Sir John insisted that Keegan had left the club in a better position than he found it when taking charge as manager five years ago.
"Kevin has taken the club from obscurity and it now has a sound footing for the future. People should be happy with what Keegan has achieved here," he said.
"The fans should all remember the Keegan years and what he has done for this football club. The League is still there to be won and so is the F.A. Cup and UEFA Cup."
